purpose: CVPR 2027 revision: test whether the two evaluation variables (split unit, reference-label version) change which models look best, using a broader model suite. Written before any new score was computed.

fixed_inputs.reference_split: identical to results/reference_evaluation.json: all 240 audited patients withheld from fitting; union of cross-patient DINOv2-S pHash candidates (Hamming <= 6, all modalities) quarantined; test = primary-audit classifiable non-quarantined patients
fixed_inputs.training_labels: original manifest labels of unaudited, non-quarantined patients

zoo.patient_aggregation: mean of image probabilities, then argmax

finetuned.recipe: AdamW wd 0.05, cosine schedule, batch 32, class-weighted CE, random 224 crop of 256 cache + brightness jitter; lr backbone 1e-5 (DINOv2, historical recipe) or 1e-4 (CNNs); head lr 1e-3; no early stopping, no test-based selection

zoo.selection_rule: no hyperparameter, checkpoint or model selection uses any audited label

reference_variable_statistics.bootstrap: 2000 patient-bootstrap draws (seed 20261108) shared by all models and both reference versions
reference_variable_statistics.leaderboard_agreement: Kendall tau-b between manifest-scored and final-scored leaderboards; percentile interval over draws
reference_variable_statistics.winner: frequency over draws that the top-ranked model is the same under both references; identity of top model under each
reference_variable_statistics.pairwise: for every model pair, d = (s_i - s_j | final) - (s_i - s_j | manifest); a pair counts as a significant re-ordering only if the point order flips AND the 95% interval of d excludes zero
reference_variable_statistics.primary_hypothesis: H1: the final-reference leaderboard differs from the manifest leaderboard (tau-b < 1 with interval excluding 1, or >= 1 significant re-ordering)

split_variable_statistics.design: full intraoral cohort, source labels, image-level vs patient-level split, test fraction 0.3, seeds 0-4 (image split seeded 1000+s), per-image scoring in both arms (historical design)
split_variable_statistics.agreement: Kendall tau-b between regime-mean leaderboards; per-seed tau; per-entry inflation with sample SD over seeds
split_variable_statistics.primary_hypothesis: H2: memorising heads (1-NN, 5-NN) gain more under the image split than the linear head, changing the head ranking

label_analyses.oracle_ceiling: macro-F1 of the final labels scored against the manifest (and reverse) on the 221 primary classifiable cases, bootstrap interval
label_analyses.human_reference: each fixed reviewer account (expert1, expert2) scored against the manifest on 221 cases and on the 189 test cases; not-assessable counts as an error
label_analyses.changed_case_decomposition: on test cases where manifest != final: fraction of model predictions equal to the manifest label, to the final label, or to neither; zoo mean with bootstrap interval
label_analyses.case_difficulty: final-reference accuracy on initially agreed cases vs senior-adjudicated cases, zoo mean, paired bootstrap
label_analyses.label_error_detection: AUROC of 1 - p(manifest label) for predicting manifest != final on the test cases, per encoder (logreg) and for a pre-declared ensemble = mean logreg probability over all 11 encoders; confident-learning flags with per-class thresholds from 5-fold out-of-fold training probabilities; precision and recall
label_analyses.noise_robust_training: confident-learning pruning of training patients (5-fold out-of-fold logreg probabilities, per-class thresholds, prune flagged off-diagonal patients), refit, score under both references; paired difference vs unpruned per encoder
label_analyses.noise_robust_hypothesis: H3: pruning changes final-reference scores more favourably than manifest scores

fusion.late_fusion: per encoder, average patient probabilities of the modality-specific logreg models over the modalities each test patient has; compared with intraoral-only on the same 189 patients (paired bootstrap)
fusion.modality_headroom: zoo-mean logreg macro-F1 per modality on identical patients (intraoral vs OPG on patients with both; intraoral vs cephalogram on patients with both), paired bootstrap

reporting: all outcomes reported whether or not hypotheses hold; null results stated as nulls

amendments.status: exploratory, added after the frozen plan; all on cached features or stored per-patient predictions (CPU); no model is refit for selection and no audited label is used for fitting

analyses.C1_feature_distance: for ResNet-18, ConvNeXt-T, DINOv2-S, BiomedCLIP intraoral caches (and all encoders on OPG/ceph for the supplement): per image, cosine distance to its nearest other image of (a) the same patient, (b) another patient with the same source label, (c) another patient with another source label; and the fraction of images whose nearest neighbour comes from the same patient. Aggregates only -> results/feature_distance.json
analyses.C3_modality_paired: re-score the intraoral linear-probe predictions on exactly the test patients that have an OPG (resp. cephalogram) prediction, against the adjudicated label; must reproduce fusion_late.json zoo means -> results/modality_paired.json
analyses.C4_rank_stability: over the same 2,000 patient-bootstrap draws (seed 20261108) used in zoo_reference.json, probability that each entry ranks first under the source label, under the adjudicated label, and under both -> results/rank_stability.json
analyses.C5_expert_subset: macro-F1 against the source label of each expert reviewer and of fine-tuned DINOv2-S (3-seed mean of per-seed scores) on (a) all 189 test patients with not-assessable counted as an error (as in label_analysis.json) and (b) only the test patients that reviewer could assess -> results/expert_subset.json
analyses.C6_family_summary: mean patient macro-F1 per pretraining family x adaptation, both labels -> results/family_summary.json
analyses.C7_dentex_count: fill DENTEX n_images = 3903 in comparison_matrix.json from the DENTEX challenge paper (quoted fact already in number_whitelist.json) and re-render the comparison
analyses.C10_fig2_frame_probs: per-frame class probabilities of the frozen DINOv2-S linear probe (reference-split fit) for the already-published primer record only; aggregates (per-frame probabilities, no identifiers) -> results/fig2_frame_probs.json
analyses.L1_novelty_check: read DinoDental (arXiv 2603.28297) and the teledentistry study (doi 10.6026/973206300221974) to confirm neither releases a patient-linked intraoral+OPG+ceph benchmark or keeps original and expert-adjudicated labels

analyses.C11_expert_gap_ci: for each expert reviewer, paired 95% percentile interval of (reviewer macro-F1 minus fine-tuned DINOv2-S macro-F1, 3-seed mean) against the source label, over the same 2,000 patient-bootstrap draws (seed 20261108) as zoo_reference.json; rule (a) all 189 test patients with not-assessable counted as an error, rule (b) only the patients that reviewer could assess; also the share of draws in which the model scores at or above the reviewer -> results/expert_gap_ci.json
analyses.C12_lead_ci: paired 95% interval of (fine-tuned DINOv2-S minus fine-tuned ConvNeXt-T) and (fine-tuned DINOv2-S minus the best frozen entry, ResNet-18 linear) macro-F1 under the source and the adjudicated label, same draws -> results/expert_gap_ci.json

amendments.reason: user request 2026-11-16 (state-of-the-art coverage: SAM and vision-language baselines); coordinator cut-off for new runs 2026-11-16 22:00 local
amendments.status: post-plan entries, added after the frozen plan; reported whatever the outcome in the leaderboard (separate block), the appendix and one main-text sentence; NOT added to the pre-registered 33-entry statistics (tau_b, pair shifts, rank stability, AUROC, cleaning), which stay unchanged
amendments.privacy: local models only; patient images are read in place and never leave the machine; no external API
amendments.selection_rule: selection uses only the 593 unaudited training patients (source labels); the 189 audit-held-out test patients are scored once with the selected configuration; no audited label is used for selection

analyses.P1_sam_vitb_linear: SAM ViT-B image encoder (facebook/sam-vit-base, transformers SamModel, SamProcessor: longest side 1024 + pad, SAM normalisation), frozen, intraoral photographs only. Two candidate image features from the same forward pass: (a) mean-pooled 256-d neck output (the image embedding SAM's mask decoder reads), (b) mean-pooled 768-d final ViT hidden state before the neck. Head: the frozen-protocol linear probe (standardised, C=1, class-balanced, max_iter 2000), patient = mean of image probabilities. Feature choice (a vs b) by 5-fold patient-grouped stratified CV patient macro-F1 on the training pool (source labels); tie -> (a). Fit on the full training pool (same quarantine/split masks as zoo.predict), predict the 189 test patients once. Heavy step via .cache/cvpr27/run_heavy.sh only -> data/feat_cache/sam_vitb_intraoral.npz
analyses.P2_zero_shot_clip: zero-shot CLIP-B/16 (open_clip ViT-B-16 openai) and BiomedCLIP from the existing cached image embeddings (encode_image outputs, L2-normalised) and locally computed text embeddings of four pre-declared prompt templates for Class I/II/III; image probabilities = softmax(model logit_scale * cosine); patient = mean of image probabilities. Template per model selected by patient macro-F1 on the 593 training patients (source labels, no fitting); score the 189 test patients once. CPU only
analyses.P3_optional_local_vlm: a small local open generative VLM only if P1 and P2 finish with compute to spare before the cut-off; otherwise not run and not claimed
analyses.scoring: macro-F1 (primary) and balanced accuracy against source and adjudicated labels, 95% intervals over the same 2,000 patient-bootstrap draws (seed 20261108) as zoo_reference.json, paired difference to the current leader (fine-tuned DINOv2-S, mean of 3 seeds) -> results/postplan_baselines.json
analyses.stop_rule: if any post-plan entry's point estimate exceeds the current leader under either label, stop and tell the coordinator before any claim is changed; the abstract is fixed

a dental photograph of an Angle {cls} molar relationship
an intraoral photograph of a patient with {desc}

amendments.reason: external review (round 8): is the label-version reordering (Kendall tau_b = 0.65) larger than sampling noise or than any 64 label changes?
amendments.status: exploratory, post-plan; stored per-patient predictions of the 33 planned entries only (CPU); nothing refit; reported whatever the outcome

analyses.N1_bootstrap_pairs: 1,000 pairs of independent patient-bootstrap resamples of the 189 test patients (seed 20261117); for each pair, Kendall tau_b between the 33-entry macro-F1 leaderboards on the two resamples under the SAME label version; done separately for the source and the adjudicated label
analyses.N2_random_relabel: 1,000 draws (seed 20261117): choose 64 of the 189 test patients uniformly at random and replace each one's source label by one of the two other classes uniformly at random; Kendall tau_b between the source-label leaderboard and the relabelled leaderboard on the full test set (same predictions)
analyses.report: median and 2.5/97.5 percentiles of each null, and the share of null draws with tau_b <= 0.65 (observed source-vs-adjudicated value) -> results/label_version_null.json

amendments.reason: user decision after external review: how stable is the order of the 30 frozen entries beyond the single reference split?
amendments.status: exploratory, post-plan; cached intraoral features only (CPU, nice -n 10, < 2 GB); no audited patient is used; fine-tuned entries stay on the fixed reference split; reported whatever the outcome

analyses.R1_repeated_cv: patient-level stratified 5-fold CV repeated 5 times (shuffle seeds 0-4) over the 593 unaudited, non-quarantined training patients (the reference-arm training pool), source labels; the same folds for all 30 frozen entries (10 encoders x linear / 1-NN / 5-NN, frozen-protocol heads); patient = mean of image probabilities; patient macro-F1 per held-out fold -> per entry mean and SD over the 25 folds and over the 5 repeat-level pooled scores
analyses.R2_tiers: corrected repeated k-fold t-test (Nadeau-Bengio variance correction, factor 1/25 + 1/4) on per-fold differences, two-sided 5%; tier 1 = best mean entry plus all entries not significantly below it; then repeat on the remaining entries -> results/repeated_cv.json

amendments.reason: external review request: were the 240 audited patients selected in a class-dependent way? (post-plan)
amendments.status: post-plan descriptive check; patient-level source labels only (seconds, CPU); nothing is fitted; reported whatever the outcome

analyses.D1_audit_selection: source (manifest) label counts of the 240 audited patients (updates/OrthoLabel_EDA.xlsx, sheet 'Analysis Data', column manifest_label) versus the unaudited patients (union of DINOv2-S feature caches over intraoral/OPG/cephalogram, label_numeric, patients not in the export); 2x3 Pearson chi-square without continuity correction -> scripts/audit_selection_check.py, results/audit_selection.json. The sampling rule itself is not recorded in the export and is not inferred.
analyses.C0_resnet50_collapse_note: no new analysis: read predicted-class counts of the three stored fine-tuned ResNet-50 runs (data/preds/finetune_reference_preds.npz) and the scores in results/finetune_reference.json, and compare with a constant Class-I prediction on the same 189 test patients; written to results/audit_selection.json under resnet50_collapse

amendments.reason: external review request: the protocol fine-tuned ResNet-50 collapsed (seeds 0 and 1 predict Class I for every test patient); does a lower backbone learning rate with warmup train it? (post-plan)
amendments.status: post-plan entry; reported next to the protocol ResNet-50 row, which stays unchanged; not added to the 33-entry statistics; reported whatever the outcome; GPU/MPS via .cache/cvpr27/run_heavy.sh, one seed per call
amendments.selection_rule: no selection: the recipe is fixed here and is not tuned on test or train; the backbone rate 1e-5 is the protocol rate of fine-tuned DINOv2-S

analyses.C1_resnet50_warmup: fine-tuned ResNet-50 (ImageNet-1k V2 weights) on the reference split (593 training patients, 4,133 photographs; 189 test patients), identical to the protocol recipe (batch 16, 8 epochs, AdamW, head lr 1e-3, weight decay 0.05, 224 random crop of the 256 cache, brightness jitter, class-weighted cross-entropy, patient = mean image probability) except backbone lr 1e-4 -> 1e-5 and a linear warmup of both learning rates from 0 over the first epoch (259 steps) followed by cosine decay to 0 over the remaining 1,813 steps; seeds 0, 1, 2 -> scripts/review_resnet50_warmup.py, results/review_runs/resnet50_warmup_s*.json; aggregated with the shared 2,000 bootstrap draws (seed 20261108) into results/review_resnet50_warmup.json: entry = 3-seed mean, macro-F1 against source and adjudicated labels with 95% intervals, paired difference to the protocol ResNet-50 entry and to fine-tuned DINOv2-S, predicted-class counts per seed

amendments.reason: external review request: does a learned fusion of the three record types beat the complete-case concatenation and photographs alone? (post-plan)
amendments.status: post-plan; cached frozen features only (CPU); historical complete-case cohort and source labels, comparable with results/fusion.json and not with the reference-split leaderboard; reported whatever the outcome
amendments.selection_rule: all learned components (stacking layer, modality weights) are fitted on out-of-fold probabilities of the training patients of each split; nothing is chosen on the test patients

analyses.B1_learned_fusion: the 285 patients with all three record types; patient vector = L2-normalised mean image feature; the same 10 stratified 70/30 patient splits (seeds 0-9) and class-balanced logistic probe (C=1) as results/fusion.json. Methods per split: photos only; concatenation of the three blocks (both as fusion.json); stacking = per-modality logistic heads + multinomial logistic layer (balanced, C=1) on their 5-fold out-of-fold log-probabilities; weighted = per-modality heads averaged with simplex weights (step 0.1, 66 candidates) that maximise out-of-fold macro-F1 (ties -> closest to uniform). Two feature sets: primary 'rad' = DINOv2-S photographs + RAD-DINO OPG + RAD-DINO cephalogram (as requested); 'dinov2' = DINOv2-S for all three (the exact features of results/fusion.json, whose photos and concatenation numbers must reproduce). Statistics: mean and SD over the 10 splits, splits won, and 95% intervals of the 10-split mean and of paired differences from 2,000 patient-bootstrap draws per split (seed 20261108 + split seed), averaged across splits draw by draw. Primary comparisons: stack minus concat and stack minus photos on 'rad'. -> scripts/review_learned_fusion.py, results/review_learned_fusion.json

amendments.reason: external review request: a multiple-instance baseline that learns which photographs matter, instead of averaging frame probabilities (post-plan)
amendments.status: post-plan entries; cached frame embeddings only (CPU, via .cache/cvpr27/run_heavy.sh, one config or seed per call); not added to the 33-entry statistics; reported whatever the outcome
amendments.selection_rule: hyperparameters are chosen by patient-grouped stratified 5-fold CV (shuffle seed 0) on the 593 training patients with source labels only; the 189 test patients are scored once with the selected configuration

analyses.A1_attention_mil: gated attention-MIL (Ilse, Tomczak, Welling, ICML 2018): frame embedding -> Linear(d,128)+ReLU+dropout -> gated attention (V,U: 128->64, w: 64->1, softmax over the patient's frames) -> weighted sum -> Linear(128,3); Adam, batch 16 bags, class-weighted cross-entropy; frame features standardised with statistics of the training frames. Encoders: DINOv2-S (384-d cached features) and SAM ViT-B (768-d mean-pooled ViT state, the feature selected for the SAM post-plan entry). Grid: lr {1e-4, 1e-3} x weight decay {1e-4, 1e-2} x dropout {0, 0.25}, evaluated after 20, 50 and 100 epochs (24 candidates); selection = highest mean CV patient macro-F1 (ties: earlier grid entry, fewer epochs). Final model refit on all 593 training patients with seeds 0, 1, 2; entry = mean of the 3 seeds' scores, as for fine-tuned entries. Scoring: macro-F1 against the source and the adjudicated label with the shared 2,000 patient-bootstrap draws (seed 20261108); paired difference to the linear probe on the same encoder (DINOv2-S / logreg leaderboard entry; SAM ViT-B / logreg post-plan entry) and to fine-tuned DINOv2-S; rank if inserted among the 33 entries -> scripts/review_abmil.py, results/review_abmil.json. The bibliography entry for Ilse et al. (PMLR vol. 80, pp. 2127-2136) is verified with tools/verify_citations.py.
